subject: Mathematics
title: Three Dimensional Geometry
summary: Space mein points ke coordinates (x, y, z) hote hain. Direction cosines (l, m, n) l² + m² + n² = 1 satisfy karte hain; direction ratios unke proportional koi bhi numbers hain. Distance aur section formulas 2D jaise hi.
Line ko vector form r = a + λb ya Cartesian form (x − x₁)/a = (y − y₁)/b = (z − z₁)/c mein likhte hain. Skew lines na milti hain na parallel hoti hain; unka shortest distance JEE favourite hai.
Plane r · n = d ya ax + by + cz + d = 0 hai. Planes aur lines ke beech angle, point ki plane se distance, foot of perpendicular, image aur lines ki coplanarity yaad rakho.

formulas.name: Distance and section
formulas.formula: d = √((x₂ − x₁)² + (y₂ − y₁)² + (z₂ − z₁)²);  internal division m:n as in 2D with z included

formulas.name: Direction cosines
formulas.formula: l = cos α, m = cos β, n = cos γ;  l² + m² + n² = 1;  from ratios (a, b, c): l = a/√(a² + b² + c²), …

formulas.name: Line through two points
formulas.formula: (x − x₁)/(x₂ − x₁) = (y − y₁)/(y₂ − y₁) = (z − z₁)/(z₂ − z₁)

formulas.name: Angle between lines
formulas.formula: cos θ = |a₁a₂ + b₁b₂ + c₁c₂|/(√(a₁² + b₁² + c₁²)√(a₂² + b₂² + c₂²));  perpendicular: a₁a₂ + b₁b₂ + c₁c₂ = 0;  parallel: a₁/a₂ = b₁/b₂ = c₁/c₂

formulas.name: Shortest distance (skew lines)
formulas.when: Skew lines r = a₁ + λb₁ aur r = a₂ + μb₂ ke beech distance.
formulas.note: SD = 0 ho to lines intersect karti hain.

formulas.name: Plane forms
formulas.formula: r · n = d;  ax + by + cz + d = 0 (normal (a, b, c));  intercept x/a + y/b + z/c = 1;  through 3 points: determinant = 0

formulas.name: Angle between planes / line and plane
formulas.formula: planes: cos θ = |n₁ · n₂|/(|n₁||n₂|);  line and plane: sin φ = |b · n|/(|b||n|)

formulas.name: Coplanarity of two lines
formulas.when: Kya do lines ek plane mein hain?

formulas.name: Foot of perpendicular and image in a plane
formulas.formula: (x − x₁)/a = (y − y₁)/b = (z − z₁)/c = −(ax₁ + by₁ + cz₁ + d)/(a² + b² + c²);  image: multiply the right side by 2

formulas.name: Foot of perpendicular and image in a LINE
formulas.formula: line r = a + λb: general point M = a + λb;  solve (M − P) · b = 0 for λ;  foot = M;  image P′ = 2M − P;  distance = |PM|
formulas.when: Point ka line par projection ya reflection (upar wala plane formula yahan nahi lagta).
formulas.mistake: Direction ratios (x − x₁)/a form se padho: (7 − z)/2 = (z − 7)/(−2), to direction ratio −2 hai, 2 nahi.

examples.title: Lines ke beech angle
examples.problem: Direction ratios (1, 1, 0) aur (0, 1, 1) wali lines ke beech angle?

examples.title: Shortest distance
examples.problem: Lines r = λî aur r = 2k̂ + μĵ. Shortest distance?
examples.solution: b₁ × b₂ = î × ĵ = k̂; (a₂ − a₁) · k̂ = 2 ⇒ SD = 2.

examples.title: Direction cosines
examples.problem: Ratios (2, 3, 6) wali line ke direction cosines?

examples.title: Teen points se plane
examples.problem: (1, 0, 0), (0, 2, 0) aur (0, 0, 3) se guzarne wala plane nikalo.

examples.title: Line mein point ki image
examples.problem: P(4, 0, 2) ki line (x − 1)/2 = (y + 1)/1 = (3 − z)/2 mein image?

topics.title: Projection
topics.explain: Direction cosines (l, m, n) wali line par segment PQ ka projection |l(x₂ − x₁) + m(y₂ − y₁) + n(z₂ − z₁)| hai.

topics.title: Intersection of two lines
topics.explain: Dono lines ke general points parameters λ aur μ ke saath likho, coordinates barabar karke do equations solve karo; teesri check karo. Wo bhi sahi ho to lines intersect karti hain.

topics.title: Line and plane relations
topics.explain: Line plane mein hai agar line ka ek point plane par ho aur b · n = 0. Line plane ke parallel hai agar b · n = 0 par line ka koi point us par na ho.

topics.title: Symmetric form from two planes
topics.explain: Do planes ki line of intersection ki direction n₁ × n₂ hai; dono planes par ek point dhoondho (jaise z = 0 rakho) aur line likho.

topics.title: Angle bisector planes
topics.explain: a₁x + b₁y + c₁z + d₁ = 0 aur a₂x + … = 0 ke beech angles ke bisector planes normalised distances barabar karke milte hain, 2D jaisa.

topics.title: Vector vs Cartesian
topics.explain: Aaram se badlo: r = a + λb ⇔ (x − a₁)/b₁ = (y − a₂)/b₂ = (z − a₃)/b₃. Vector forms mein cross aur dot products seedhe lagte hain.

ratta: Point–plane distance |ax₁ + by₁ + cz₁ + d|/√(a² + b² + c²).
Line mein image: M = a + λb, PM·b = 0 se λ;  image = 2M − P.
